finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Yep,” Minaga nodded before looking back and forth as if to make sure no one else was listening in. Once the coast was clear – ignoring the confused kneeling Chosen – the Unique Lifeform leaned in.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “What? No, Jake didn’t ask me to do anything,” Minaga said, shaking his head. “I was asked by Minaga.”
